ops.caption: A has a local event: it increments its own slot a. A = [1,0,0]
A sends its vector to B. B takes the element-wise max with its own: max(0,1) = 1 for slot a
B then increments its own slot b: 0 → 1. B is now [1,1,0]
Meanwhile, and concurrently with A's send, C has a local event: it increments its own slot c. C = [0,0,1]
B sends its vector to C. C takes the max with its own: max(0,1) = 1 for slot a
C then increments its own slot c: 1 → 2. C is now [1,1,2]
